_doc: [eggs2] Lumi's collection and the Museum (systems/museum.gd). Every collectible in the game is an exhibit here: the Codex Collection page lists them with counts and silhouettes, and the Museum (a late build at Verdance's Cradle Returns, once the Cradle has answered) shows each on a plinth; empty plinths show a ghost of what is missing. Filling every plinth is the 100% goal (flags.museum_complete, achievement museum_complete). kind: egg (flags.egg_<ref>), egg_parts (collected parts of a collect: true egg, total = its parts), eggs (curiosities found; total = every egg except where 'new_world'), shards (memory shards found), trinkets (Collection), relic (Homeward relic id), flag (any GameState flag, for other planets' finds). shape: the Codex silhouette (gnome, cat, capsule, tv, duck, star, cube, shard, box, gem, telescope, dot). prop: an EggProps kind built on the plinth (optional). planet: where it is found (display only). hint: shown while missing (egg kinds fall back to the egg's own hint). cost is in the three currencies.

exhibits.name: Gnome Patrol
exhibits.hint: Five garden gnomes guard Old Town's streets. Pick them up.

exhibits.name: The Last Broadcast
exhibits.hint: A TV on a lawn chair is still on. Adjust the antenna.

exhibits.name: Cabinet of Curiosities
exhibits.hint: Every curiosity on every planet (Codex > Curiosities has the hints).

exhibits.name: Memory Shards
exhibits.hint: Letters, notes and drawings surface as the ground is cleaned.
